title: Lawyers are Dishonest? Quantifying Representational Harms in Commonsense Knowledge Resources

bias_targets.methodology: Converting commonsense knowledge graph triples and downstream generative model outputs into natural language statements, masking the target origin words (e.g., nationalities), and applying sentiment and regard classifiers to quantify intra-target overgeneralization (prejudice/favoritism) and inter-target disparity.
